# 2 Chronicles Chapter 26 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** And-they-took all people-of Judah Uzziah and-he was-son-of sixteen years and-they-made-him-king in-place-of his-father Amaziah.

**2** He built Eloth and-he-restored-it to-Judah after lay-down the-king with his-fathers.

**3** Son-of sixteen years was-Uzziah in-his-reigning and-fifty-and-two years he-reigned in-Jerusalem and-name-of his-mother was-Jecoliah from-Jerusalem.

**4** And-he-did the-right in-eyes-of YHWH according-to-all that did Amaziah his-father.

**5** And-he-was seeking God in-days-of Zechariah the-understanding in-vision-of God and-in-days-of his-seeking YHWH He-made-him-prosper God.

**6** And-he-went-out and-he-fought against-the-Philistines and-he-broke-down wall-of Gath and-wall-of Jabneh and-wall-of Ashdod and-he-built cities in-Ashdod and-among-the-Philistines.

**7** And-He-helped-him God against the-Philistines and-against the-Arabians the-dwelling in-Gur-baal and-the-Meunites.

**8** And-they-gave the-Ammonites tribute to-Uzziah and-his-name went to entrance-of Egypt for he-strengthened-himself to-upward.

**9** And-he-built Uzziah towers in-Jerusalem at gate-of the-corner and-at gate-of the-valley and-at the-angle and-he-fortified-them.

**10** And-he-built towers in-the-wilderness and-he-dug cisterns many for cattle much was-for-him and-in-the-Shephelah and-in-the-plain farmers and-vinedressers in-the-mountains and-in-the-Carmel for loving-of soil he-was.

**11** And-there-was to-Uzziah an-army making war going-out to-battle in-bands according-to-number-of their-muster by-hand-of Jeiel the-scribe and-Maaseiah the-officer under hand-of Hananiah from-commanders-of the-king.

**12** All number-of heads-of the-fathers of-the-mighty-of valor two-thousand and-six-hundred.

**13** And-under their-hand army-of force three-hundred thousand and-seven thousand and-five-hundred making war with-power-of might to-help the-king against the-enemy.

**14** And-he-prepared for-them Uzziah for-all the-army shields and-spears and-helmets and-coats-of-mail and-bows and-stones-of slings.

**15** And-he-made in-Jerusalem devices invention-of an-inventor to-be on the-towers and-on the-corners to-shoot arrows and-stones great and-it-went-out his-name to-far for he-was-made-marvelous to-be-helped until he-was-strong.

**16** And-as-he-was-strong was-lifted his-heart to-destruction and-he-was-unfaithful against-YHWH his-God and-he-came into temple-of YHWH to-burn-incense on altar-of the-incense.

**17** And-he-came after-him Azariah the-priest and-with-him priests-of YHWH eighty men-of valor.

**18** And-they-stood against Uzziah the-king and-they-said to-him not to-you Uzziah to-burn-incense to-YHWH but to-the-priests sons-of Aaron the-consecrated to-burn-incense go-out from the-sanctuary for you-have-been-unfaithful and-not to-you for-honor from-YHWH God.

**19** And-he-was-angry Uzziah and-in-his-hand a-censer to-burn-incense and-in-his-anger with the-priests and-the-leprosy broke-out on-his-forehead before the-priests in-house-of YHWH from-beside altar-of the-incense.

**20** And-he-turned to-him Azariah the-chief priest and-all the-priests and-behold he was-leprous in-his-forehead and-they-rushed-him from-there and-also he hastened to-go-out for struck-him YHWH.

**21** And-he-was Uzziah the-king a-leper until day-of his-death and-he-dwelt in-house-of the-freedom a-leper for he-was-cut-off from-house-of YHWH and-Jotham his-son was-over house-of the-king judging the-people-of the-land.

**22** And-rest-of acts-of Uzziah the-first and-the-last wrote Isaiah son-of Amoz the-prophet.

**23** And-he-lay-down Uzziah with his-fathers and-they-buried-him with his-fathers in-field-of the-burial that was-for-the-kings for they-said a-leper he is and-he-reigned Jotham his-son in-his-place.


---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **26:5**: in-days-of his-seeking YHWH He-made-him-prosper — The Chronicler's cause-and-effect: seeking God produces prosperity. The temporal qualifier 'in days of' foreshadows the reversal to come.

- **26:15**: until he-was-strong — The pivot word. Everything before this is blessing; everything after is judgment. Strength becomes the doorway to pride.

- **26:16**: was-lifted his-heart to-destruction — The Hebrew le-hashchit (to destruction) reveals that pride is self-destructive. Uzziah's sin destroys him, not others.

- **26:19**: the-leprosy broke-out on-his-forehead — Immediate divine judgment. The leprosy appears at the precise moment of angry defiance, before the assembled priests.


— EMET
